With seven varied-u and varied-gradient observations and the branch probe already paid for, test the archived four-parameter barrier law using multistart least squares rather than buying another measurement or treating execution errors as scientific refutation.

All observations share the same horizon and the selected law is static, not the archived multi-state memory ODE that needs a trajectory batch.

Plausible competitor, but the observed barrier-onset signature and task-specific barrier-siphon family favor refitting the stated barrier law; earlier model attempts did not provide a valid numerical fit.
